## Contracts, consumers, and exclusions
Preserve immutable snapshot purpose and exports; single-flight cache population, recency, exclusive inode accounting, and delete-on-close safety; faithful donor hardlinks with unlink-before-rewrite, unshareable paths, and fail-closed fallback; and operation-linked GC with O(1) stamps, stamped interlocks, detached-worker bounds, and run_gc serialization. Preserve local/network fetch bounds, credential classification, targeted ref safety, low-throughput aborts, common-directory coordination, and bounded retries. Preserve janitor pressure triggers, hysteresis, LRU rename-before-delete, inode accounting, corruption reverify, and every interlock. Preserve code and ticket tree materialization, LFS/submodule caveats, blob prefetch, live ticket-store pinning, atomic publication, cache accounting, and fetch prerequisites. Consumers are attested plan/code/completion gates, cache handles, operation-linked GC, and diagnostics; no allowlisted docstring is a help or schema source.

Concise or load-bearing prose outside the allowlist stays byte-identical. So do every runtime string, assertion, fixture, decorator, command argument, config key/value, and physical directive/shebang line. Repository-wide __doc__/inspect.getdoc census found no programmatic consumer of an allowlisted docstring.

## Verification and independent review
Compare each final file to d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84. For Python, parse with type_comments=True, replace only leading docstrings owned by the allowlisted Module/ClassDef/FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef owners, normalize only ast.TypeIgnore.lineno, and require the remaining AST/runtime tree to match. A zero-context diff-hunk guard permits changes only inside the cited base spans; directive/shebang physical lines must match exactly. Run the structured focused, path, hygiene, diff, and untimed repository commands.

A reviewer who did not author the patch records a leaf-linked TSV with one PASS row per edited block (78 total): stable_id, before_citation, final_citation, preserved_contract_or_consumer, directives_exact, before_words, final_words, reviewer_session, semantic_pass, bloat_pass. Every final_words value must be smaller; missing, extra, or FAIL rows block closure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Exactly the 78 allowlisted blocks are shortened; no other prose or directive changes.
- [ ] The immutable-base prose-only oracle passes for all 7 files.
- [ ] Every preserved contract above has a concrete independent-review PASS citation.
- [ ] HEAD^..HEAD changes exactly the declared paths; focused checks, diff-check, hygiene, and make verify exit 0.
- [ ] The independent TSV has exactly 78 complete PASS rows and proves a word-count reduction per block.
